instruction: I want to change VLC's recording folder to my Desktop directory. Currently recordings go to the default location, but I'd prefer them saved to /home/user/Desktop. How can I configure this?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VLC's recording folder path to /home/user/Desktop (input-record-path=/home/user/Desktop). Uses existing is_vlc_recordings_folder metric to verify the setting in vlcrc config file.
